01 · Who we are

Every child deserves a home that holds steady.

Lighthouse Children Welfare Home Association gives shelter to children and young people who have nowhere safe to go. For many, this is the first place where meals are regular, bedtime is calm and an adult is always nearby.

The Home is run by a dedicated committee and caregivers, and depends on the generosity of Malaysians to cover food, schooling, medical care and the daily running costs of three homes across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor.

02 · What we do

Four things every child here can count on.

  1. 01

    Safe shelter

    A secure, loving home with caregivers present day and night.

  2. 02

    Education

    School fees, uniforms, tuition and books so no child falls behind.

  3. 03

    Health & wellbeing

    Nutritious meals, medical care and counselling support.

  4. 04

    Skills & joy

    Music, sport, festive celebrations and life skills for the road ahead.

04 · Get involved

There is a way for everyone to help.

  • Give monthly

    A steady gift lets the Home plan ahead, and is the single most useful thing you can do.

  • Give once

    Cover a special need: medical bills, school fees, a festive celebration.

  • Give goods

    Clothes, toys, books and festive treats are always welcome. Please call ahead.

  • Give time

    Tutor, mentor, play music or share a skill with the children.
